2607.15176.title: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Scientific Visualization Literacy
2607.15176.paper_summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used to interpret visualizations, yet current evaluations remain largely chart-centric and provide limited evidence of understanding of scientific visualization (SciVis). We benchmark six MLLMs on the scientific visualization literacy assessment test, a standardized SciVis literacy assessment comprising 49 items based on 18 scientific visualizations and illustrations, spanning 8 techniques and 11 task types. We evaluate three closed-source and three open-source models under a closed-world protocol and compare their performance using data from 485 human participants. Results show that current MLLMs do not exhibit uniform SciVis literacy. Gemini is the strongest model overall, exceeding the human mean across the evaluated subsets, whereas the open-source models remain below the human baseline. Performance is highly uneven across techniques and tasks: models perform best on scientific illustration, search, and spatial understanding, but struggle on texture-based and integration-based visualizations and on quantitative estimation. Error analysis reveals recurring failures in fine-grained quantitative estimation, flow-direction interpretation, and grounded encoding interpretation. These findings position SciVis literacy as a necessary benchmark dimension for evaluating multimodal AI systems. Our code and model outputs are publicly available at https://github.com/patdmp/mllm-scivis-lit-benchmark.
2607.15176.paper_summary_zh: 多模態大型語言模型（MLLMs）越來越多地被用來解釋視覺化，但目前的評估仍然主要集中於圖表，並且對科學視覺化（SciVis）的理解提供的證據有限。我們對六個MLLMs進行了基於科學視覺化素養評估測試的基準測試，這是一項標準化的SciVis素養評估，包括49個項目，基於18個科學視覺化和插圖，涵蓋8種技術和11種任務類型。我們在封閉世界協議下評估三個封閉源和三個開放源模型，並使用485名人類參與者的數據比較它們的表現。結果顯示，目前的MLLMs並未展現出一致的SciVis素養。Gemini是整體上最強的模型，在評估的子集上超過了人類平均水平，而開放源模型則低於人類基準。不同技術和任務的表現非常不均衡：模型在科學插圖、搜索和空間理解上表現最佳，但在基於紋理和基於整合的視覺化以及定量估計上表現不佳。錯誤分析顯示在細粒度定量估計、流向解釋和基於實體的編碼解釋方面存在重複的失敗。這些發現將SciVis素養定位為評估多模態AI系統所需的基準維度。我們的代碼和模型輸出可在https://github.com/patdmp/mllm-scivis-lit-benchmark上公開獲取。
